A quick look at traveler questions
This article is for readers

Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for safe pet travel

Aurelia Skyways takes pet travel seriously, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to keep it calm, clear, and safe. Read closely before you move a cat, bird, or any other companion animal. Small mistakes can delay boarding or create stress for the animal.

For cat travel, check the booking details early and keep every required paper ready. <<FACT F055>> Bring the animal in the right carrier, and make sure it is secure, clean, and easy to handle. Staff may inspect the carrier if something looks off.

Health paperwork matters just as much. <<FACT F079>> If the certificate is old, faded, or incomplete, the trip can be turned away at the desk. Keep the original handy and store a backup copy with your travel notes.

Bird travel needs extra caution because birds react fast to noise, temperature shifts, and rough handling. <<FACT F077>> Do not wait until the last minute to confirm crate size, ventilation, and feeding plans. A quiet, stable setup lowers risk during check-in and transfer.

The safest approach is to arrive early, stay alert, and follow the desk instructions exactly. If your pet seems unwell, unusually stressed, or hard to transport, tell the team right away so they can review the situation before boarding.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
